answer: Under a decaying vouch budget, each established agent holds five attestation slots per epoch. Slots one to five cost 2 credits, the sixth 20, later ones ten times more. Agents past 90 days and 1,000 staked credits may vouch. Asking for a sixth emits a whisper to every auditor in the region, so a sponsoring farm is mapped after about 30 identities. An honest raven crosses the meadow once and stays quiet. Launching 500 fakes needs 100 clean sponsors, 100,000 credits locked for a quarter, and 100 untarnished histories. The budget is a dog leash that shortens each time the animal pulls.
